title: AppDatabase composition function and readiness
scenario: Tessellate's platform team is replacing the ticket that asks for a Cloud SQL database with a Crossplane v2 API: developers create a namespaced AppDatabase in their team namespace and get an instance, a database, a user and a connection secret. You write the composition logic (what a function-style pipeline step would return) and the composite reconcile loop that applies it, prunes what is no longer desired and reports Ready honestly.
task: Validate the XR and return a Fatal result with the field path instead of panicking
Compose namespaced sql.gcp.m.upbound.io MRs with deterministic names, labels, tier and version maps, deletion policy and provider config reference
Add a read replica and REGIONAL availability for size large
Reconcile idempotently over the fake client: apply only what changed, prune what is gone, stay inside the XR namespace
Set Synced and Ready conditions; Ready names the resources still not ready
acceptance: Visible and hidden go test suites pass with -race
A second reconcile of an unchanged XR issues zero Apply/Delete calls
Downsizing large to medium deletes the replica; other namespaces are untouched
ANSWER.md explains the v2 choices (namespaced XR, no claim, ClusterProviderConfig default) and deletion behavior
